_comment: Shipped preset for MoGe-2 monocular geometry estimation, adapted from ComfyUI's official 3d_moge_perspective_to_mesh template (flattened: auto-resize branch and normal-map previews dropped). Chain: LoadImage #1 + LoadMoGeModel #2 -> MoGeInference #3 (resolution_level 9, fov auto) -> MoGePointMapToMesh #4 (decimation 1, discontinuity 0.04, textured) -> SaveGLB #5. Deterministic — no seed. Sky/invalid pixels are culled via the model's own mask.
label: MoGe-2 Depth Mesh
description: MoGe-2 image-to-geometry: lifts one upstream photo into a textured 3D point-map mesh (GLB) of the visible surfaces — scene relief, not a full closed object. Requires moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16.safetensors in models/geometry_estimation — see workflows/model/README.md. Optional custom param: resolution_level (0-9, default 9).

image.error: MoGe needs an upstream image — wire one into this stage's images slot.
